claim: The contract layer exists because: (1) implicit contracts were scattered across structs, skills, and the agent-instruction file with no unified representation (b133), (2) contracts must be domain-bound, surviving code rewrites while remaining mechanically verifiable (b134), (3) the same contract representation must govern behavior across different substrates - compiled code and LLM reasoning (b135). This positions contracts as the abstraction layer between domain expertise and implementation.
